newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: SMH in watch venture with Calvin Klein.
newsitem.headline: SMH in watch venture with Calvin Klein.

text.p: Swiss watchmaker Ste Suisse Microelectronique et d'Horlogerie SA (SMH), home of the Swatch brand, said it had launched a venture with U.S. fashion and design company Calvin Klein, Inc.
SMH and Clavin Klein said in a joint statement they would found a new company, held 90 percent by SMH, to launch two lines of watches for autumn 1997.
"A new company, CK Watches SA, has been created by SMH and will produce and distribute the Calvin Klein Collection and cK Calvin Klein watch lines from Biel, Switzerland," the statement said.
The other 10 percent of the venture is held by Calvin Klein, Inc. CK Watches SA is the fourteenth watch company within the SMH group, alongside such names as Swatch, Blancpain and Omega.
Calvin Klein, Inc will share design responsibility with SMH.

The statement said the Calvin Klein Collection watches would be prestige, limited edition styles while the cK Calvin Klein line would be designed and priced for "the more fashion-forward cK customer".
The watches would be sold in existing Calvin Klein stores around the world and through SMH distribution channels in department stores and specialty retailers.
